title: Heaven’s Vice
description: Levi and Gideon are brothers. And angels. But they’re not in heaven anymore.
quote: After everything I’ve been through… being sent to Purgatory by my evil twin, getting eaten by a kraken, giving birth to the Antichrist. Twice. I need to be with someone stable.
altHero: Levi and Gideon with their angel wings

alt3: Gideon leaving as Levi hugs Angelica
alt4: Gideon looking contemplative, with Levi and Angelica behing him
